article.title: Grounds of opinion, when relevant
article.content:
45Grounds of opinion, when relevant

Section 45 · Part II · Chapter II · Opinions of third persons when relevant
Whenever the opinion of any living person is relevant, the grounds on which such opinion is based are also relevant.
Illustrations
An expert may give an account of experiments performed by him for the purpose of forming his opinion.
